# Separate ClockOracle research contract — source preparation

Root adopts this prospective contract after independent review by
`/root/critic_history_linux_allocator` of preparation packet D7E13A33 and pins
9D145A2D. This is authority to prepare a NEW source revision only. It grants no
numeric prices, work limit, binding, parsing, compilation, test or execution GO.

## Historical result and unchanged limits

The old ClockOracle R4 source/guards/caps remain exact. Its quoted scalar-action
lower bound is 17,821,237,248, exceeding its private 2^34 cap. That stage stays
NOFIT. DefinitionR4's first GREEN, original profile and all old receipts/proofs
remain immutable. This is not a repair or passing result for the old contract.

Preserve all 56 logical clock/inverse files, 16,929,027 dense words, 785 fraction
pairs/carry, full prefix/ramp/window/burst/native-inverse/metadata laws, eleven
numeric and eight runner controls, and BOTH actual checked production endpoints
for every Q. Preserve all numerical acceptance thresholds and supported domains.

Production 2^28 work, 512MiB new prepared bytes and 1GiB peak remain unchanged.
Research retains 840MiB admitted artifacts, 32MiB controlled explicit scratch,
1800s per child, one heavy headless lane, one-use/unreset accounting and actual
cancellation/reap/read settlement/quarantine. Compiler CPU/internal heap/RSS and
temporary peak disk remain unqualified. No renderer, Ready or activation credit.

The NEW limit is NOT SELECTED. First close the exact complete runner/producer/
verifier upper U and their payload/error lifetimes. Derive one finite checked
limit from that U, then obtain independent review before immutable data binding.
Choose no convenient power of two, padding, multiplier, split or budget reset.

## Prospective research scalar convention

Apply the preparation's explicit scalar convention with these clarifications:

- Count each reached scalar/literal read, destination initialization/write,
  arithmetic/bitwise/comparison/boolean/conversion, selected branch, call entry/
  dispatch/return and actual loop/control event once. This is not CPU cycles.
- Caller evaluation supplies the source read of a by-value copy. Callee parameter
  initialization supplies its destination write; do not invent a second source
  read for the same copy. Reference arguments do not copy their referents.
- Guaranteed direct prvalue construction initializes its destination once.
  Optional NRVO alternatives retain their real copy/move obligations.
- Uninitialized storage has no invented zero value or write. Explicit constructor
  entry/return and any independently defined lifetime event are separate facts.
- Expand selected C++ SDK/STL and our helper bodies under the pinned source and
  compiler profile. No optimizer or new opaque-category discount supplies fit.
- Existing OS/CRT/libm and CLR codec/JSON runtime internals remain the declared
  primitive CPU/general-heap boundary. Public source availability does not move
  that boundary. Audit behavior and every controlled payload/clone/temporary
  without claiming primitive CPU, general CLR heap, allocator overhead or RSS.
- Count all quotation, Catalogue, Meter/Spend, validation, default/aggregate,
  receipt, failure and retirement source in a finite nonrecursive schedule.
  Reservations/quoted upper work are distinct from measured actual visits.

This convention is prospective and distinct from the earlier elementary/API
Euclid-six certificate and production ADR0085's logical primitive contract.
Neither historical model is rewritten or retroactively certified under it.

## Selected serialization route: A, existing trusted built-in objects

Keep the actual source-built maps/arrays and existing JSON format. A new wire-node
platform is unnecessary for the closed actual runner caller graph. Admit exact
concrete containers/comparers and null, Boolean, String and actual signed/unsigned
integral types, including Int32/UInt16/UInt32. Reject unsupported objects without
stringifying them. Do not serialize arbitrary parsed properties.

Project the exact twelve C++ summary fields and exact control schemas/IDs/reasons/
six integral operands. Validate any parsed predecessor fields copied into output.
All normal witnesses and primary raw outcomes remain. Unknown fields/types refuse.

Use a fresh pinned `-NoProfile -NonInteractive` controller, explicit trusted
imports and exact serializer binding. Establish the actual source graph has no
relevant type-data/property augmentation or serializer-default registration.
PowerShell preprocessing and extended-property behavior require this closed-domain
audit; the library also has a global default-settings hook. Sources:
[PowerShell JsonObject](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/v7.6.5/src/Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.Utility/commands/utility/WebCmdlet/JsonObject.cs),
[JsonConvert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JamesNK/Newtonsoft.Json/13.0.4/Src/Newtonsoft.Json/JsonConvert.cs).
Verify exact installed module identities/version-to-source mapping before relying
on those sources; version names alone are not a compiled-binary certificate.

Before serialization or variable normalization/copy/join, check exact container
counts/depth, String lengths, scalar types, finite visits and all arithmetic.
Repeated aliases are repeated serialization visits. Admit source-built sizes
before each allocation/copy; do not fabricate convenient node/cardinality limits.

A checked byte UPPER is sufficient; exact serializer length prediction is optional.
Prefer explicit EscapeNonAscii: safe ASCII one byte, quote/backslash/short escape
two, other escaped UTF16 unit six; include punctuation, integer digits, Boolean/
null and final LF. Specify surrogate validity and safe prefix truncation. This
behavior must match the pinned [escaping source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JamesNK/Newtonsoft.Json/13.0.4/Src/Newtonsoft.Json/Utilities/JavaScriptUtils.cs).
Keep the actual encoded-length check against both preflight and document cap.

Encode receipts ONCE under the receipt cap, then pass those bytes to a bounded
writer. Use preflight lengths for bundle fixed-point iterations, then one final
encode. Include preprocessing clones, escape/output buffers, returned UTF16,
Replace/LF results if retained, UTF8 bytes, prior buffers, parsed results, source
containers and quarantine in simultaneous payload phases. No 32MiB fit is granted.

## Other mandatory source corrections

Admit Repo/NewRunRoot and derived suffix lengths before variable path copies/
scans. Bound C++ argv root/manifest/mode before std::string/strcmp traversal or
enforce an equally explicit exact launcher domain. Bound C++ exception diagnostic
output. Use bounded structured failure-inventory diagnostics, not full messages.

Preserve the primary error/raw child result separately from footer/fence/serializer
failures; a throwing finally fence must not replace the primary cause. Record both
outcomes and keep raw exits/logs. Footer failure always prevents certification.
Do not serialize opaque Exception/ErrorRecord graphs into the controlled schema or
claim their general CLR heap is bounded by the controlled scratch worksheet.

Include actual split/filter callback prefixes and join delimiters, or replace them
with genuine reviewed bounded source. Close all bootstrap/34 existing helpers/new
helpers/main/76 C++ families and their transitive source/error/instrumentation rows.
Recompute exact lineage/namespace/include/hash/byte/slot profiles, including every
new source, contract, census and eventual constant-data identity. Equal bytes do
not merge distinct paths or simultaneous owners.

New sources retain false guards and unbound private immutable Catalogue data.
Fresh whole functional review precedes complete independent census/lifetime review,
derived-limit review, binding-source review and separate root one-attempt GO.
No source maximum, partial floor or manual PASS supplies any missing proof.

# Research census: declared primitive call boundary

Source-only clarification of separate contract344408DAEC2BD355D44B0B6DA266BF00119B09DF5028B70524699E8E2CD36010.
This is the research scalar convention, not production ADR0085's logical primitive
model or a reinterpretation of any historical certificate.

- Count evaluated caller arguments/reference formation and dispatch, plus the
  declared primitive boundary's entry and return. An actually reached visible
  wrapper has its own entry/body/return; do not merge it with the primitive.
- Existing declared CRT/OS/libm/intrinsic and CLR runtime/JSON implementation CPU
  remains opaque. Public implementation source does not expand that boundary.
  Selected C++ SDK and all newly authored helper bodies remain expanded.
- External scalar/result/out-buffer destination writes occur once. A guaranteed
  result initialized directly into the caller destination is not another value
  transfer or second destination write. Caller evaluation supplies its value read;
  actual parameter initialization supplies its write, without a second input read.
- Reference arguments copy no referent cells. Actual reference formation/binding
  and implicit receiver actions are accounted once under the research convention;
  generic forwarding does not manufacture a second referent copy.
- All controlled payloads, buffers, clones, capacities, preprocessing and retained
  owners still need their complete lifetime worksheet. Primitive CPU/general CLR
  heap/RSS exclusions do not turn an explicit array into physically freed storage.

No price, work limit, constant data, payload fit or execution authority is supplied.
Root relayed this same boundary to both independent runner and C++ census reviewers.

# Research census: bulk primitive clarification

This clarifies DE33D91712372C2FE887A02FB137AA9A96C8C3BB93CB0D88BF57AA32DBEAE564
under unchanged separate contract344408DA. Both records remain source-only.

The accepted preparation's library row and the selected C++ transitive-closure
map explicitly preserve the bulk CRT/OS/CLR/libm primitive CPU boundary. In
particular, an explicit SDK memcpy remains a bulk primitive; its surrounding
visible wrappers and source calculations remain expanded.

- For a declared opaque memcpy, memmove, memset, fread or corresponding existing
  bulk CLR primitive, count its evaluated caller arguments, dispatch, boundary
  entry/return and visible wrappers. Do not count n internal byte writes, invent
  a per-byte source loop, or add a new bulk-scalar fee on top of that call.
- Explicit scalar results and scalar out-parameter destinations are initialized
  once. Guaranteed direct caller-result initialization is not another transfer.
  The earlier record's out-buffer wording does not reopen bulk primitive internals.
- Fully retain byte extents, capacity, lifetime, old/new overlap and controlled
  payload obligations. An opaque CPU body grants no storage reclamation or fit.
- Visible C++ aggregate/default/per-field initialization, copy and retirement
  retain their actual source actions. Do not replace those semantics with a
  hypothetical optimized memcpy. Selected C++ SDK wrappers stay expanded; existing
  CLR/codec runtime internals retain their accepted distinct primitive boundary.
- Count an actually invoked selected special member's entry, receiver binding,
  return and real field actions. Empty bodies are not optimizer-discounted.
  Aggregate initialization that invokes no constructor gets no invented one;
  uninitialized storage gets no fabricated zero/write, and an uninvoked special
  member gets no call. Do not invent a field loop for trivial retirement.

This supplies neither prices nor a new work limit. The old R4 NOFIT, all source
seals, production policy and resource limits remain unchanged. Future independent
review must inspect actual primitive-versus-visible call incidence.
